report_or_finding: 9/11 Commission Final Report Chapter 7 — Bayoumi knowledge/intent negative finding
investigator: National Commission on Terrorist Attacks Upon the United States
employer_controller: Independent bipartisan commission created by U.S. law
exact_wording: we have seen no credible evidence that he believed in violent extremism or knowingly aided extremist groups.
scope: Bayoumi's belief in violent extremism or knowing assistance to extremist groups; this finding does not deny that he provided documented practical assistance to Hazmi and Mihdhar.
records_reviewed: FBI interviews and reports cited in Chapter 7 notes
telephone and subscriber records cited in Chapter 7 notes
Saudi Civil Aviation employment records provided by the FBI
CIA analytic reporting cited in Chapter 7 notes
records_unavailable: The exact source chain for all later Operation Encore evidence was not part of the 2004 Commission record and remains to be mapped.
workpapers_status: Public report notes identify many underlying records, but not all workpapers/interview memoranda are reproduced in the report itself.
competing_findings: The 2016 Operation Encore EC documents later FBI rereview of the encounter, communications, statements, and assistance network.
notes: Preserve the distinction between documented assistance and the separate proposition of knowing extremist assistance or plot knowledge.
